goal: Let AgileCockpit present proposed implementation plans for human review, approval, deferral, or rejection before work begins.
notes: Idea captured from I-0020 planning discussion on 2026-06-26.

Acceptance Criteria: 1. Requirements without Epic AC coverage are identified from the current RTM. 2. Final-review acceptance criteria for uncovered requirements are recorded under EP-023. 3. Each EP-023 acceptance criterion links to at least one requirement that lacked AC coverage. 4. Each EP-023 acceptance criterion has at least one test definition that verifies the traceability path.
outOfScope: Replacing existing human-only verification or closeout gates.
Allowing agents to self-approve implementation plans.
rationale: Planning conversations currently happen outside the human-facing cockpit. Capturing proposed plans in AgileCockpit would make scope, expected changes, and approval state visible before implementation without conflating planning approval with final verification.
scope: Define a plan record or presentation model for proposed implementation work.
Show plan scope, file changes, commands, external effects, and verification criteria in AgileCockpit.
Support explicit human approve, defer, and reject decisions.
Record plan decisions in canonical state, audit events, or evidence records as appropriate.
Preserve existing authority boundaries for human-only verification and closeout.
